rule: Owner-approved drafts promoted into the P0 registry (p0_catalog.registry appends them). A promoted guide sits right after the guide named in "after" (its archived predecessor or the guide it sits next to), else at the end. Archived guides keep their registry record with availability archived; their files are in archive/guides/<date>/<id>/ and can be restored. A promoted id that already exists in the registry (decision rerender, or a revised promoted record) replaces that record in place.

record.title: Walk up to the door
record.technique: constant-pace chest-height walk from 4.5 m to the door
record.invariant: Door centred, phone at your chest. Walk straight at it at an even, slow pace.
record.sourceSetup:
- **Target frame**: the door fills about 0.9 of the frame width, centred; the handle sits right of centre inside the safe box.
- **Camera**: rear 1x, chest height 1.30 m, about 3 deg down, walk 4.5 m -> 1.5 m from the door at a constant 0.61 m/s over 5 s; the phone does not re-aim.
- **Objects**: as entrance_walk_in (closed glazed door, sign, welcome stand, room through the windows); hero is the door handle.

record.title: Board down to the counter
record.technique: pure tilt down from the board to the counter, 2x
record.invariant: Feet still, 2x, tilt down slowly from the board to the cups.
record.sourceSetup:
- **Target frame**: the board fills 0.85 of the width, its bottom edge at 60% of the frame; the counter top is a
  thin line at the bottom of the band.
- **Objects**: hero: the board (`menu_board`); support: counter edge with a card holder and one cup on it
  (`cup`); background: the shelf of cups; light cue: pendant above the counter (`pendant`), its pool on the
  counter top.
- **Placement**: as in 4; the cup at x = 0.4 m on the counter top.
- **Camera**: start 1.0 m from the counter edge, height 1.1 m (just above the counter), tilt -5 degrees on the
  cup and the counter edge (cup fills 0.35 width, right of centre); tilt up 35 degrees over 4 s to the board,
  no walking.
- **Filming guideline**: "Start on the counter, tilt up until the board fills the frame." Tip: rest the elbows on
  the counter edge.
- **Render**: new scene from the `menu_board` and `cup` assets; tilt only.

record.title: Pour at cup height
record.technique: static three-quarter pour just below the cup rim
record.invariant: Hold the phone still in front of the counter edge, lens just below the cup rim, about 30 cm away, through the pour.
record.newObjects: espresso machine turned 90 deg clockwise (working face to the left, side panel to the client; owner ruling), resting on the counter top; drying cups and glasses upside down on top
record.sourceSetup:
- **Target frame**: the cup at the right third, 0.7 width, the stream a bright line from the top-left into it,
  the window behind as a soft rectangle; the counter top at 72%.
- **Objects**: hero: the cup; action: pitcher and stream (as in 15) from the top-left; support: the saucer;
  background: window (`window`) 1.5 m behind; light cue: rim highlight on the stream and on the cup's left edge
  (backlight explains the choice).
- **Placement**: cup at the origin; window at z = -1.5 m, sill at 1.0 m; the pitcher spout at (-0.1, 0.12 m).
- **Camera**: 0.35 m from the cup, height 0.08 m above the counter, azimuth -20, tilt 0; still hold of 5 s; the
  pour from second 0.5 to 4.
- **Filming guideline**: "Phone at cup height with the window behind the cup, hold still through the pour."
  Tip: rest the phone's bottom edge on the counter.
- **Render**: adapt `glass_pour_low_in_cd` (a low pour into a glass) to the cup, without the push-in; still.

record.title: Short orbit around the plate
record.technique: 40 degree orbit, 40 degrees of arc
record.invariant: Elbows on the table, swing the phone around the plate at one even pace, same distance all the way.
record.sourceSetup: Pitch 40 deg, slant radius 0.38 m constant, azimuth -20 -> +20 deg in 4 s; objects as in plate_high_orbit.

record.technique: static 45 degree view, plate turned 90 degrees by hand
record.invariant: Hold the phone still at 45 degrees; with one hand on the rim, turn the plate a quarter turn slowly.

record.title: Sip, cup only
record.technique: static 45 degree view while one hand lifts the cup out of frame
record.invariant: Hold the phone still at 45 degrees on the cup, then lift the cup up and out of frame by its handle; the saucer stays.
record.sourceSetup: Static portrait, 45 degrees down, 40 cm from the cup on 1x. Cup on its saucer, handle to the right-front; the window behind and to the left. One right hand lifts the cup by its handle up and toward the drinker until it leaves the top of the frame; the saucer stays. 4 s.
record.sourceInvariant: Phone still at 45 degrees on the cup; lift the cup up out of frame, the saucer stays.

record.title: Slide along the board

record.newObjects: espresso machine turned 90 deg clockwise (working face to the left, side panel to the client; owner ruling), resting on the counter top; drying cups and glasses upside down on top
record.sourceSetup:
Audit row (section 2): adjust speed and height. Old: lens 1.85 m, 0 deg, 1.14 m at 0.29 m/s in 3.9 s. Research variant B2 (truck along the board).
Change: the truck covers one column step (middle column centred at the start, drinks column centred at the end) because a full board pass (1.14 m) at 10-15 cm/s takes 8-11 s (judgement). Lens lowered from 1.85 to 1.6 m and pitched up 6.5 deg instead of level. Duration stays 4 s.
Owner review: three support cups on the coffee machine (two on the drip shelf, one on the top), clear of the hero rows.

record.title: Board straight on
record.technique: static straight-on hold, 2x
record.invariant: Step back, 2x, phone straight at the board, hold still.
record.sourceSetup:
- **Target frame**: the board's right third (the drinks column) fills 0.9 of the width; rows read as bars.
- **Objects**: hero: wall board 1.8 x 0.9 m, three columns of six rows (`menu_board`); support: the counter top
  edge along the bottom of the band at 68% (a 2 m line, faint); background: a shelf of cups behind the counter
  (three `cup` repeats, fainter); light cue: a spot pool on the board's right column (yellow, soft).
- **Placement**: board bottom at 1.5 m on the back wall (z = -1.2 m from the counter edge); counter edge at the
  origin; cups on a shelf at height 1.3 m, z = -1.1 m.
- **Camera**: 1.4 m from the board, height 1.6 m, azimuth 0, eye-level; truck right from x = -0.6 m to x = +0.6 m
  over 4 s at an even pace. The board's left column is the start, the right column the target.
- **Filming guideline**: "Phone level, slide sideways past the board at one even pace." Tip: step sideways, do not
  turn.
- **Render**: reuse `menu_board_eye_truckr_mm`; re-time to the P0 clock.

record.title: Your cup at the counter

record.sourceSetup:
- **Target frame**: the cup on its saucer at the centre of the band, 0.8 width (medium), the counter edge at 70%

- **Objects**: hero: cup and saucer (`cup`, `saucer`); action: one hand from the far side (`real_hands`,
  entering top-right at second 1, placing the cup at second 2.5, leaving by second 3.5); support: the counter
  edge, a card holder; background: machine side (faint); light cue: pendant pool.
- **Placement**: counter edge along x at the origin; the cup lands at z = -0.15 m; the hand's path from (0.5,
  -0.6) to the cup.
- **Camera**: 0.6 m from the counter edge, height 1.35 m (counter + 0.3), azimuth 0, tilt -20 degrees on the
  landing spot; a still hold of 4 s, the still trigger fires on the steady frame before the hand arrives.
- **Filming guideline**: "Frame the empty spot on the counter, hold still, let the cup arrive." Tip: start the
  take before the barista calls your name.
- **Render**: new scene; the contact rule applies (hand on the cup handle, cup on the saucer).

- **Objects**: as entrance_sign_tilt (hanging sign, door, welcome stand, room through the windows); hero is the door.
record.sourceInvariant: Start on the sign, tilt down to the door, then two steps in.

record.title: A friend films you walking in

- **Target frame**: the open doorway centred, the creator seen from behind in the doorway.

- **Objects**: open glazed door, sign, welcome stand, room through the windows and doorway, the canonical creator in its source pose.

record.title: Counter up to the board
record.technique: pure tilt up from the counter to the board, 2x
record.invariant: Feet still, 2x, tilt up slowly from the cups to the board.
record.newObjects: espresso machine turned 90 deg clockwise (working face to the left, side panel to the client; owner ruling), resting on the counter top; drying cups and glasses upside down on top
record.sourceSetup:
Audit row (section 2): adjust height or distance, speed, framing. Old: lens 1.13 m, tilt 0.6 down to 18.1 up plus a 22.8 deg yaw, peak 15.4 deg/s, 2.29 m at 1x, board past the right 85% edge. Research variant: reverse of B3 (accepted mirror, audit judgement).
Change: lens up from 1.13 to 1.5 m, 2x from 3 m, the yaw removed, end pitch 4.8 deg up, the hero narrowed from the whole board to the centre column (the 1.8 m board is wider than a 2x frame at 3 m, judgement). Start frame: the counter front edge with the cups on the counter top. Duration 4 -> 3 s.

record.title: Over your shoulder at the counter
record.technique: friend over your shoulder, slow 20 cm push-in
record.invariant: A friend films over your right shoulder at shoulder height, pitched slightly down, and pushes in about 20 cm toward the cup and machine.
record.newObjects: espresso machine turned 90 deg clockwise (working face to the left, side panel to the client; owner ruling), resting on the counter top; drying cups and glasses upside down on top
record.sourceSetup:
- **Target frame**: the board upper-left on the thirds crossing, the counter edge as a diagonal from the lower-left
  to the middle-right, the pass with one cup on it at the right third; the creator's shoulder is not drawn.
- **Objects**: hero: the board and the pass cup together (`menu_board`, `cup` on the counter); support: the
  espresso machine behind the counter (check `cafe_first_visit.py` for the machine; otherwise generate: a
  0.7 x 0.45 x 0.5 m box with a group head and a steam wand); background: shelf of cups; light cue: pendant pool
  on the counter.
- **Placement**: counter edge along x at the origin; pass cup at x = 0.6 m, z = -0.3 m; machine at x = 0.9 m,
  z = -0.8 m; board on the back wall at z = -1.3 m, bottom at 1.5 m.
- **Camera**: 0.9 m from the counter edge, height 1.5 m, azimuth +25 degrees (over the right shoulder),
  over-shoulder tilt 20 degrees; a still hold of 5 s (the barista's hands may enter from the far side at second
  2 to place the cup: one hand, `real_hands`).
- **Filming guideline**: "Phone over your shoulder on the board and the counter, hold still while you order."
  Tip: the front camera PiP can record your face at the same time.
- **Render**: the existing `over_shoulder_counter_os_hold` has three phases (grinder, espresso, milk) over 7.2 s;
  keep only the cup-placed phase at 5 s.

  cue: window light from the left on the cup's left edge (rim cue).
- **Placement**: counter edge along x; the cup at x = 0 (origin), 0.1 m in from the edge; machine at x = -0.3 m,

- **Camera**: start 1.3 m left of the cup (x = -1.3 m), 0.25 m out from the counter edge, height 1.2 m
